GOV-F-003-S114.title: Crash-Safe Lock Recovery and Stale Lock Takeover
GOV-F-003-S114.description: Implement recovery logic to detect expired locks via TTL and allow safe takeover by a new owner. Ensure atomic compare-and-set behavior to prevent dual ownership during recovery scenarios.

GOV-F-003-S115.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S115.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flow. Ensure all assignment execution paths require a valid lock and gracefully handle lock loss or expiration.

GOV-F-003-S116.title: Comprehensive Lock TTL and Ownership Test Suite
GOV-F-003-S116.description: Create unit and integration tests validating TTL expiration, ownership enforcement, renewal behavior, race condition handling, and recovery takeover scenarios. Include failure injection for crash simulation.
